name: openoutreach_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the openoutreach capability.

prompts.name: lead_identification_prompt
prompts.template: Describe your product: {product_description}. Find leads that fit this description.
prompts.use_case: Startups seeking targeted B2B leads for new product launches.

prompts.name: lead_explanation_prompt
prompts.template: Explain why this person is a good fit: {lead_profile} for the product described as {product_description}.
prompts.use_case: Sales teams automating personalized outreach at scale.

prompts.name: email_generation_prompt
prompts.template: Generate a personalized outreach email for lead {lead_name} based on the following template: {email_template}.
prompts.use_case: Marketing departments improving lead quality with AI insights.
